description.zh: 在食堂或常去的店，点一道你从来没点过的菜。
description.en: At the canteen or a place you know, order a dish you’ve never tried.

description.zh: 白天换一条没走过的路去上课或回宿舍，路上找一个新发现。
description.en: In daylight, take a route you’ve never used to class or your dorm and spot one new thing.

doneWhen.zh: 到达目的地，说得出一个新发现
doneWhen.en: You arrive and can name one new thing you saw

title.en: Three songs from a new genre

description.zh: 在网易云或 QQ 音乐上挑一种你平时不听的风格，比如戏曲、爵士或民谣，完整听三首。
description.en: On NetEase Cloud Music or QQ Music, pick a genre you never play, like opera, jazz or folk, and listen to three full songs.

description.zh: 在图书馆走到一个和你专业无关的书架，随手抽一本读 10 页。
description.en: In the library, go to a shelf unrelated to your major, pull out any book and read ten pages.

description.zh: 今天课上没听懂的一个点，或刷到的一个“为什么”，花 10 分钟把它查清楚。
description.en: Take one point you didn’t get in class today, or a “why” you saw online, and spend ten minutes looking it up.

doneWhen.en: You can explain the answer in one sentence

description.zh: 在校园里找一个让你觉得好看的细节，拍下来。
description.en: Find one detail on campus that looks beautiful to you and take a photo of it.

description.zh: 去你最喜欢的店点常点的东西，想想它为什么让你舒服。
description.en: Go to your favorite place, order your usual, and notice what makes it comfortable.

doneWhen.zh: 吃完，能说出一个舒服的理由
doneWhen.en: You’ve eaten and can name one reason it feels good

description.zh: 重看一集你已经看过很多遍的剧或动画。
description.en: Rewatch an episode of a show you’ve already seen many times.

description.zh: 买或点一道家乡口味的菜，吃的时候想想它让你想起什么。
description.en: Buy or order a dish that tastes like home and notice what it reminds you of.

doneWhen.zh: 吃完，想起一件相关的事
doneWhen.en: You’ve eaten and recalled one memory it brings back

description.zh: 用你最习惯的方式泡一杯茶或冲一杯咖啡，坐下来慢慢喝完。
description.en: Make tea or coffee the way you always do, sit down and drink it slowly.

title.zh: 翻 5 张喜欢的旧照片

description.zh: 在手机相册里翻出 5 张你最喜欢的旧照片，慢慢看一遍。
description.en: Find five favorite old photos on your phone and take your time looking at them.

title.zh: 听一首单曲循环过的歌

description.zh: 听一首你单曲循环过很多次的老歌，想想它陪你度过了哪段时间。
description.en: Play an old song you once had on repeat and think about the time it got you through.

description.zh: 睡前在备忘录写下明天最重要的三件事，比如交作业、去驿站取快递。
description.en: Before bed, note the three most important things for tomorrow, like handing in homework or picking up a parcel.

title.zh: 给拖着的事定个开工时间

description.zh: 挑一件拖着的事，比如作业、报名表或邮件，写一句“晚饭后回到宿舍，我就先做 10 分钟”，然后照做。
description.en: Pick something you’ve been putting off, like homework, a form or an email. Write “When I get back to the dorm after dinner, I’ll do ten minutes,” then do it.

doneWhen.zh: 写好计划并做满 10 分钟
doneWhen.en: The plan is written and you’ve done ten minutes

description.zh: 计时 15 分钟，把宿舍书桌整理干净。
description.en: Set a 15-minute timer and clear your dorm desk.

description.zh: 今晚定一个上床时间，到点把手机放到够不着的地方。
description.en: Pick a bedtime tonight and, when it comes, put your phone out of reach.

doneWhen.en: At bedtime, the phone is away and you’re in bed

description.zh: 找三件两分钟内能做完的小事，比如回一条微信、扔掉桌上的外卖盒，一口气做完。
description.en: Find three things that take under two minutes each, like replying to a WeChat message or throwing out a takeout box, and do them now.

description.zh: 去图书馆或自习室，手机调成勿扰，计时 25 分钟只做一件事。
description.en: In the library or a study room, set your phone to Do Not Disturb and work on one thing for 25 minutes.

description.zh: 这周末挑一天不定闹钟，睡到自然醒，起床后再决定今天做什么。
description.en: Pick one weekend day with no alarm. Sleep until you wake up, then decide what to do with the day.

description.zh: 在校园里走 20 分钟，每到路口抛硬币决定往哪边走。
description.en: Walk around campus for 20 minutes and flip a coin at every turn to decide where to go.

description.zh: 拿张纸随便画或写 10 分钟，不用画完，也不用好看。
description.en: Doodle or scribble for ten minutes. It doesn’t need to be finished or good.

description.zh: 不跟视频，按身体觉得舒服的方式拉伸 10 分钟。
description.en: Without a video, stretch for ten minutes in whatever way feels good.

description.zh: 今天不去固定的座位，走到哪觉得舒服就在哪学习半小时，比如空教室、咖啡店或草坪。
description.en: Skip your usual seat today and study for 30 minutes wherever feels right, like an empty classroom, a café or the lawn.

doneWhen.zh: 在新地方学满 30 分钟
doneWhen.en: You’ve studied 30 minutes in the new spot

description.zh: 写作业或做 PPT 时，挑一小部分，做到能交就停，不再反复改。
description.en: While doing homework or slides, pick one small part and stop once it’s good enough to hand in.

doneWhen.en: The task is done and you’ve stopped

description.zh: 买东西时和食堂阿姨、超市收银员或快递站的人多聊一句。
description.en: When you buy something, say one extra friendly sentence to the canteen worker, cashier or parcel station staff.

description.zh: 今天主动约一个同学或室友，一起去食堂或校外吃一顿饭。
description.en: Ask a classmate or roommate to eat with you today, in the canteen or off campus.

description.zh: 在课上、班会、社团或班级群里主动说一次自己的想法。
description.en: Share one of your ideas in class, at a class meeting, at a club or in the class group chat.

description.zh: 约一个人一起夜跑、打羽毛球或打球。
description.en: Ask someone to join you for an evening run, badminton or a ball game.

title.zh: 联系一个很久没聊的朋友
title.en: Reach out to an old friend

description.zh: 在微信上给一个很久没联系的朋友，比如高中同学，发条消息问问最近怎么样。
description.en: On WeChat, message a friend you haven’t talked to in a while, like a high school classmate, and ask how they’re doing.

description.zh: 在宿舍群、班级群或社团群里开一个轻松的小话题，比如“今天食堂哪个菜最好吃”。
description.en: Start a light topic in your dorm, class or club group chat, like “What was the best canteen dish today?”

description.zh: 一个人去图书馆角落或空教室坐 30 分钟，不刷手机。
description.en: Sit alone in a library corner or an empty classroom for 30 minutes without scrolling.

description.zh: 一个人去听一场讲座或看一场社团活动，不约任何人。
description.en: Go to a talk or a club event on your own, without asking anyone to come.

description.zh: 把微信和 QQ 设成免打扰 30 分钟，只做一件自己的事。
description.en: Mute WeChat and QQ for 30 minutes and do one thing just for yourself.

doneWhen.en: Thirty minutes are up and notifications are back on

description.zh: 一个人吃一顿饭，不看下饭视频，认真尝每一口。
description.en: Eat one meal alone without a video on and pay attention to each bite.

description.zh: 在宿舍或自习室戴上耳机，一个人听完一期播客或有声书的一章。
description.en: Put on headphones in your dorm or a study room and listen to one podcast episode or audiobook chapter alone.

description.zh: 一个人去校园超市、书店或学校附近的小街，按自己的节奏逛 20 分钟。
description.en: Go alone to the campus store, a bookshop or a street near campus and browse at your own pace for 20 minutes.

description.zh: 给一个帮过你的人发微信，比如帮你带过饭的室友或答疑的助教，具体说说你感谢哪件事。
description.en: WeChat someone who helped you, like a roommate who brought you food or a TA who answered your question, and say exactly what you’re thankful for.

description.zh: 为别人做一件小事，比如帮室友带饭或帮同学占座。
description.en: Do one small thing for someone, like bringing a roommate food or saving a classmate a seat.

description.zh: 听一个朋友讲 10 分钟，只听和追问，先不给建议。
description.en: Listen to a friend for ten minutes. Ask questions, but hold off on advice.

description.zh: 给爸妈或家里人打个电话或视频，不为任何事，就是聊聊天。
description.en: Call or video chat with your parents or family for no reason except to chat.

description.zh: 真诚地夸一个人一个具体的地方，比如“你今天讲得很清楚”。
description.en: Give someone a sincere, specific compliment, like “You explained that really clearly today.”

description.zh: 把一份有用的课件笔记、复习资料或链接发给可能需要的同学。
description.en: Send useful lecture notes, review materials or a link to a classmate who might need them.

description.zh: 有礼貌地拒绝一个你其实不想答应的小请求，比如凑单、占座或临时被拉去的饭局。
description.en: Politely turn down a small request you don’t want to take on, like joining a group order, saving a seat or a last-minute dinner.

description.zh: 在小组作业或讨论里，说出一个和别人不一样的看法。
description.en: In a group project or discussion, share a view that differs from what others said.

description.zh: 有件事你一直等人陪才去，比如看电影、去某家店或某个地方，今天自己去。
description.en: Something you’ve been waiting for company to do, like a movie, a shop or a place, go and do it on your own today.

description.zh: 今天吃什么、周末去哪儿、选哪门选修课，挑一件不问室友也不问群里，自己定。
description.en: Pick one choice today, like what to eat, where to go this weekend or which elective to take, and decide without asking roommates or group chats.

description.zh: 今天先照顾好自己一件事，比如按时吃午饭或午睡 20 分钟，再去帮别人带饭或回消息。
description.en: Today, take care of one of your own needs first, like eating lunch on time or a 20-minute nap, before helping others or answering messages.

description.zh: 看到大家都在买或都在打卡的东西，比如新款奶茶或网红店，想想自己是不是真的想要，不想要就不跟。
description.en: When everyone is buying or checking in at something, like a new milk tea or a trendy shop, ask yourself if you really want it. If not, skip it.

description.zh: 上午去操场或阳台晒 10 到 15 分钟太阳，抬头看看天。
description.en: Spend 10 to 15 minutes in the morning sun on the track or a balcony and look up at the sky.

doneWhen.en: You’ve been outside for ten minutes

description.zh: 坐好，慢慢用腹部呼吸 5 分钟。
description.en: Sit comfortably and breathe slowly into your belly for five minutes.

description.zh: 去校园里树多的地方，比如林荫道或湖边，走 20 分钟。
description.en: Walk for 20 minutes somewhere green on campus, like a tree-lined path or by the lake.

description.zh: 去操场快走或慢跑 20 分钟，速度以还能说话为准。
description.en: Brisk-walk or jog for 20 minutes at a pace where you can still talk.

description.zh: 洗澡时不放歌也不看手机，专心感受热水，把今天的事先放一放。
description.en: Shower without music or your phone. Just feel the warm water and set the day aside for now.

description.zh: 下午犯困时，在教学楼或宿舍楼不坐电梯，爬三层楼梯。
description.en: When you feel sleepy in the afternoon, skip the elevator in your teaching building or dorm and climb three flights of stairs.

description.zh: 写 15 分钟今天让你情绪有波动的事，写完可以不给任何人看。
description.en: Write for 15 minutes about something that stirred you today. No one needs to read it.

description.zh: 把今天的一个真实感受告诉一个信任的人，当面说或发微信都可以。
description.en: Tell someone you trust one real feeling you had today, in person or on WeChat.

description.zh: 找一段让你感动的视频、文章或歌词，看完后允许自己有情绪。
description.en: Find a video, article or lyric that moves you and let yourself feel it.

description.zh: 躺下后从脚到头感受一遍身体，留意哪里紧，再睡。
description.en: Lying in bed, move your attention from your toes to your head, notice where you feel tight, then sleep.

doneWhen.en: You’ve moved from toes to head

description.zh: 写下今天让你在意的一件小事，比如群里没人回你、课上被点名，再写一句：它说明你在乎什么？
description.en: Write down one small thing that bothered you today, like no reply in a group chat or being called on in class, then one line on what it shows you care about.

title.zh: 像安慰朋友一样安慰自己
title.en: Talk to yourself like a friend

description.zh: 今天如果有件事没做好，比如考试、作业或和人闹别扭，对自己说一句你会对好朋友说的安慰的话。
description.en: If something didn’t go well today, like a test, homework or a falling-out, say to yourself what you’d say to comfort a good friend.
